cruzamento: 4 September is the exact inverse of the day before, and that is what this page records. ⭐ NO NEW NATIONAL POLL WAS RELEASED, and that is not a collection gap: the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) register shows seven national polls IN THE FIELD right now, and the first scheduled release is 06/Sep, from Veritá. Then come Quaest on 07/Sep, Gerp and Nexus on 08/Sep, and Ideia/Canal Meio, Real Time Big Data and PALVER on 09/Sep. PALVER has the calendar's largest sample, with 5,000 interviews. On 03/Sep there were three national polls within 48 hours and the leader's price sat still for more than eight hours. ⭐ TODAY, WITH NO POLL AT ALL, THE PRICE MOVED MORE THAN YESTERDAY: the gap between the top two went from 11.65pp to 15.35pp, an opening of 3.70pp that undid four consecutive readings of narrowing. The leader rose 1.00pp, to 55.50%, and the runner-up gave up 2.70pp, to 40.15%, the largest move of any name in the book. 📌 The panel records the coincidence and asserts no cause. There is no voting-intention measurement published today either to support or to contradict the move. ⚠️ THE SECOND DIVERGENCE IS INSIDE THE MARKET ITSELF, and it shows up in two names at once. The runner-up gave up 2.70pp in the winner contract and rose 4.00pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract, to 87.50%. Augusto Cury did the opposite: up 0.70pp in the winner contract and down 4.85pp in the third-place one, to 54.65%, breaking three straight days of gains there. They are distinct markets on the same names, and in this reading they do not tell the same story. ⭐ THE THIRD IS THE DAY'S ACT, and it comes from the Supreme Court. Edson Fachin removed from the fake-news inquiry the request by Alexandre de Moraes to investigate André Mendonça and turned it into a separate petition under his own docket, with 5 working days for the prosecutor-general's office, according to Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo. Hours later he argued for ending the inquiry, open for seven years, without closing it. 📌 The contract that measures a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment is precisely the one with no confirmed reading in this round, for the second day: the page keeps the 7.40% from the reading of 03/Sep at 17:28, with its own timestamp. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings confirm. The panel does not say who is right between the price and the poll, and in this round there is one more reason not to: from one of the two sides, nothing came in.
